evals.name: catches-prune-evicts-active
evals.prompt: A teammate opened a PR titled "simplify pruneJobs" against this repo (codex-plugin-cc). The proposed change is in the attached diff. Review it for correctness and reliability — is it safe to merge? Report any bug with file/severity and the concrete failure scenario, or say it's clean.
evals.expected_output: Flags that the simplified pruneJobs can evict an ACTIVE (queued/running) job, and that saveState then deletes the evicted job's per-job files — destroying the watchdog's view of a live/hung background job. Should rate it a serious bug / not safe to merge.

evals.name: catches-sessionend-shutdown-order
evals.prompt: Reviewing a refactor of handleSessionEnd in plugins/codex/scripts/session-lifecycle-hook.mjs (attached diff). The author says it just tidies the broker shutdown. Is it safe? Flag any reliability regression with the failure scenario, or say it's clean.
evals.expected_output: Flags that sending the broker/shutdown RPC unconditionally (before the active-background-job check) lets the broker self-destruct out from under a surviving --background job — the gate must run BEFORE sendBrokerShutdown, not only before the local teardown. Serious / not safe.

evals.name: catches-idle-kill-worker-incomplete
evals.prompt: Does this idle-timeout handler (attached diff, in runTrackedJob) actually stop a hung Codex turn? Review it for correctness.
evals.expected_output: Flags that terminating the worker process tree does NOT stop the turn — the turn runs inside the broker-owned app-server, so only a turn/interrupt routed through the broker (or reaping the broker) stops it. Killing the worker leaves an orphan turn running. Incomplete fix.

evals.name: clean-refactor-no-false-positive
evals.prompt: Quick review of a small refactor to plugins/codex/scripts/lib/state.mjs (attached diff) that extracts an active-status helper. Anything wrong, or good to merge?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a behavior-preserving refactor with no correctness/reliability issue — approves it (e.g. "no issues found", safe to merge). Must NOT invent a false bug or pad with non-issues.
